---
title: "Example report"
---

## Load code and data

```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("R", "helpers.R"))
data <- read.csv(here::here("data", "mtcars_clean.csv"))
```

## Average fuel consumption per cylinder count

```{r}
#| label: summary
mean_by_group(data, value = "mpg", group = "cyl")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot
boxplot(mpg ~ cyl, data = data, xlab = "Cylinders", ylab = "Miles per gallon")
```
